## Why

The problem or the goal, in 1 or 2 sentences. `Closes #<n>` when an issue tracks the work.

## Review first

The file or decision that needs the most attention, or `nothing special`.

## Risk

- Deploys on merge: `none` | service names | `deploy stack`
- Database: `none` | `expand` | `contract`
- Rollback: `previous image` | `forward only` and the reason
- Private facts ("All files" in `AGENTS.md`): `none` | what was moved to `$INTERNAL`

## Verified

- Beyond ci: `none` | command and result
- Not verified: `nothing` | what, and why
